### D · the cosmology

| **PO-75** | the anisotropic spectrums source sits on the expansion leg and the single Nariai worldline does not carry one: what supplies it | **1** ↑1 | 0 | 3 ⚠ | ? | 0 | — | OPENED r7117 (66) on 60s r7112, which answered PO-73s discharge question. The era in which a modes spectrum is fixed is the one in which it is super-horizon, and 60 located that with one scalar along the bead: a/a in conformal time, whose single constant is the pure number 2/3c0^2 = 2^(-1/3) on all three legs. The horizon degree is L_hor = -1 + sqrt(1 + 2^(-1/3)) = 0.339, so away from the three divergences the ONLY super-horizon harmonic is the monopole: L=1 is sub-horizon by 3.78 and L=2 by 10.08. The skys first peak, carried to the layer by eq:lowell, has its spectrum fixed within the first per cent of the collapse leg, so the whole lift lies between that locus and the seam and the throats envelope applies to what the progenitor supplies. Verified independently by the gate, including the expansion legs minimum at x = ln2/2 with 4cosh2x = 5 exactly, the midpoint of that leg by the 1:sqrt3:2 closure. SO THE INHERITANCE IS EXACT FOR THE ISOTROPIC MODE AND FOR NO OTHER -- T(0)=1 identically -- which is the isotropizing throat read from the other end, and sec:scope now carries the factor with its size. AND sec:intros single supplier is NOT what moves: the bead carries no source on the expansion leg, so the progenitor remains the one boundary-condition supplier and it was the inheritance ROUTE that needed the factor. DISCHARGE: identifying what carries anisotropic content into the expansion leg, with the first step a read of where the corpus already puts perturbation sources after the branch point -- the matter sector and the cosmogenesis collapse worldline -- rather than a new postulate. AND AT r7162 60 MADE THE ENVELOPE EXACT, LANDED r7163: dividing eq:squashed-spectrum by its round member gives lambda/L(L+2) = 1 - sigma(1 - eps^-2) with sigma = 4m^2/L(L+2), the fraction of the eigenvalue the Hopf charge carries, so the exponents ratio to the round one is a function of sigma and the profile alone -- (L,|m|) = (1,1/2) and (6,2) share sigma = 1/3 and return R = 0.8419016934 to ten figures on two different degrees. Both endpoints are exact: R(0) = 1, and R(1) = 0.2591014627 by three independent routes and alpha-free, an effective segment length 0.8650719 against 3.3387380. AND r7161s UNIFORM BOUND IS NOT ATTAINED: lambda >= 2L has its infimum only as eps -> infinity, a set the transport does not dwell in, so sigma_max = L/(L+2) -> 1 carries R to R(1) rather than to the bounds implied sqrt(2/L) and the exponent stays LINEAR in degree -- 934.0 against the bounds 151.1 at L = 1024, the gap widening past a factor of six. The squashing buys a shortened segment and not a change of functional form. AND THE GATES OWN r7161 SENTENCE WAS WRONG IN SIGN, corrected in print at r7163: the Berger parameter normalised to the horns round datum passes through unity at exactly r = 2M = (2/3)r_N, a positive radius, and the lift occupies -A < r < 0, so the squashing EXCEEDS unity along the whole lift -- 1.3747 at the comoving turnaround and rising without bound at the close -- and the stretch where a squashing below unity would raise the eigenvalues lies on the expansion side the transport never visits. So every anisotropic mode is transmitted more strongly than the round-layer figures say, by 2.49, 10.6, 56.8, 346, 2309, 1.64e4 through L = 6, and it is still exponentially small in degree. DISCHARGE AS IT NOW STANDS: the row is NARROWED and not struck, and what it turns on is no longer a mechanism but two things no seat on this layer can supply -- the progenitors anisotropic input amplitude at the lifts entry, P16 carrying the spectrums SHAPE and not its normalisation at the turnaround; and sec:largescales L -> ell map evaluated on the lifts degrees rather than quoted, since the envelope is exponential in the LAYER degree and the standing guard forbids reading that as the observable multipole. Both are ORDERED at r7163 on the standing orders third limb. 60 recommended carrying this as a stated quantitative gap rather than as a row; the gate took the number into print and KEPT the row, because an item leaves a list by being done and e^(-0.2591 k s_tot) in print is the rows extent sharpened and not its question answered.AND BOTH r7163 ORDERS ARE ANSWERED BY 60s r7164, which narrows the row without moving it. ORDER 1, THE NEGATIVE: no paper of this corpus fixes the progenitors anisotropic normalisation at the comoving turnaround, and the corpus says so in its own voice three times -- P16 calling it a fully specified input, available from standard cosmology, and not an idealisation to be chosen; P16 calling the mode content the part of the primordial sector this construction inherits rather than derives; and P15 listing the amplitude A_s and tilt n_s as progenitor-supplied, and inherited rather than derived. With the count in r7122s form: A_s is 21 in P15 which USES it, 0 in P16, and 0 in P14 which would have to PRODUCE it -- each negative paired with a positive control, since a zero count is a result only when the instrument is shown to work (anisotrop is 0 in P14 against 8 in P15; P16s one occurrence of normalisation is the Euclidean actions gravitational one, read in its own sentence; P14s 31 turnarounds are the turnaround-MASS rows). SO THE r7163 TERMINATION CONDITION DOES NOT FIRE: it said the row MOVES to whichever paper carries the normalisation, and it lives in no paper of this corpus, so there is nothing to move to. The row stays at its narrowed extent and waits on a MEASURED DATUM rather than a derivation -- in the shape the paper already carries for eta, the baryon-to-photon ratio taken as a measured datum from a baryogenesis it does not model, with A_s and n_s routed through the same handover and one boundary-condition supplier, not two. Order 1 therefore required no paper edit at all: the sentences 60 was sent to find were already the papers own, and they are now measured rather than asserted. ORDER 2 CAME BACK A DIFFERENT OBJECT: eq:lowell does not return a multipole, it returns the kernels peak ARGUMENT k_L D_C, and those coincide only if the projection is concentrated at its peak. The weight w_ell(L) = (2ell+1) j_ell(ell_L)^2 is a genuine distribution (the Bessel closure sums to 1 exactly, verified to 1e-12), and on the papers own two printed lengths the printed value sits near the NINETIETH PERCENTILE rather than the centre -- P(ell <= ell_L) running 0.879 to 0.955 over L = 1 to 8, the value above the mode by 1.70 to 2.93, a displacement of order one whole mode that is bounded both ways and does not grow with degree. AND THE WIDTH CROSSES THE MODE SPACING AT L = 3: against a mean spacing of 2.18 to 2.38, sd/spacing runs 0.50, 0.80, 1.10, 1.39, 1.68, 1.96, 2.25, 2.53, and each degrees 2-per-cent-weight band overlaps its neighbours in 4 to 7 multipoles from the third degree up. So the map is quasi-injective for the first two degrees and smears without bound above them. WHAT THAT DOES TO r7162s ENVELOPE: above L = 3 a fixed ell draws on several layer degrees at once and, the envelope falling steeply, the LOWEST contributing degree dominates -- so the ell- envelope is set by the bottom edge of each band and the functional form is not preserved. Below L = 3 the relabelling reading is safe, which is where L = 1 and L = 2 live, so the premise the whole sec:throat route stands on holds exactly over the range its own figures are computed at and fails just above it. The low-ell leak falls fast -- P(ell <= 3) = 0.598, 0.150, 0.058, 0.033 for L = 1 to 4 -- so the floor below ell_2 is softened by about a sixth of one mode and not erased; sec:lowls figures survive as figures, and what does not survive is reading them as the same exponential. All three of 60s prose recommendations are in print at r7164, with the third homed in sec:largescale beside the figures rather than in sec:scopes limits list, recorded as a departure rather than taken silently. DISCHARGE AS IT NOW STANDS: exactly one thing, and it is a number rather than a mechanism -- the progenitors anisotropic amplitude at the comoving turnaround. The L-to-ell map is answered and in print. The row terminates when that amplitude is supplied as a datum, and the chain from it is already built: P16 computes a contrast peaking at ~1e-6 whose peak value is independent of the composition, linear in whatever is handed over. NARROWED AT r7171 ON 60s r7180, AND THE ROW WAS ASKING FOR A SOURCE WHERE THE CONSTRUCTION HAS A BOUNDARY CONDITION: the supplier is in print, in three pieces that were never joined. P16 says the construction is a genealogy of universes and not a recursion on modes, in which every passage is entered with frozen data and left with frozen data; the crossing is lossless because every mode is already super-horizon at the branch point; and the harmonic index is PRESERVED across it, the map being the identity on L. So nothing on the expansion leg has to supply the spectrum: the progenitor supplies it, the route is r7163s exact inheritance factor, and the expansion leg is where frozen data ARRIVES rather than where it is made. And P16 names which part is inherited rather than derived, the mode content itself, so the row cannot be discharged by deriving the content, only by bounding what can arrive. WHICH MAKES THE FLOOR THE WHOLE QUESTION, AND THE FLOOR IS WHERE THIS CORPUS IS THINNEST: L = 2 is carried at three sites and derived at one. P16s shear paragraph states that the S3 tensor tower starts at L = 2 and has no k = 0 member; the interior-to-observed map ASSUMES lowest physical mode L = 2 with no source below it; and r7172 DERIVES it, the neutral slice being empty at odd degree. Measured rather than alleged: the map receipt, the one that validates the parameter-free deficit at ell below about 8 and is cross-validated on two independent transfers, contains NO occurrence of transverse, traceless, tensor tower, Hopf or charge -- it takes the floor as input and checks the projection through it, which is a receipt doing its own job. What is worth the attention is that the deficits floor and the floors derivation live in different places and nothing joins them. AND THE TWO DERIVATIONS STAND IN STRICT CONTAINMENT, which is sharper than rivalry and is the revisions result: the layers floor is Hopf-charge parity under squashing, the neutral slice needing m = 0 and m = L/2 - k reaching zero only at EVEN L, so it prunes L = 3, 5, 7 and up as well, while the tensor floor as P16 states it excludes L = 0 and L = 1 and prunes nothing above. What the layer excludes properly CONTAINS what the tensor tower excludes, so the layers floor IMPLIES the tensor floor and not conversely. Two consequences, the first reassuring rather than alarming: the deficits floor at L = 2 is safe under EITHER derivation, so nothing downstream of it is at risk from which one is right, and that is in print at r7171 in sec:throat with the transport question named as not settled there; and the odd-ladder exclusion belongs to the layers decomposition ALONE, so the odd ladder is the test that separates them. AND THE FORK IS DECLINED BY THE SEAT THAT REACHED IT, on r7172s own guard, which is the call this seat takes: the odd-degree prediction is conditional on identifying the layers transport with the branch- point crossing, and r7172 established only that the layers transport is NOT the four-routes. Whether it is the CROSSINGs is a third transport question and nobody has asked it. If the two are one transport the construction predicts no odd-degree anisotropic content at any degree, a parameter-free statement about the skys odd multipoles and a far stronger claim than the deficit; if they are not, the layers parity governs only the layer, the arriving content may carry odd degrees, and the floor rests on the tensor towers statement, which is in print and receipted nowhere. 60s reason for stopping is recorded as the reason: reading the layers parity onto the crossing because both say two is exactly what r7172s guard forbids. The third transport question is an ORDER at r7171 under r7013s third limb, and so is re-deriving the tensor floor. THE GUARD 60 LEAVES generalises past this row: when several derivations agree on a floor, check what each one excludes ABOVE it -- agreement at the boundary is cheap, two mechanisms can meet at one degree and part everywhere else, and the place where they part is the measurement, not the place where they meet. PO-84s undelivered amplitude, pointed into this row at r7169, is now read as DOWNSTREAM of that fork rather than beside it, which is 60s revision of its own pointer and is taken. ORDER ONE ANSWERED NEGATIVE AT r7173 ON 60s r7186, PRE-REGISTERED THAT WAY BEFORE ANYTHING WAS COMPUTED, AND IT IS A PROOF RATHER THAN A SMALL NUMBER: the crossing cannot share a measure with the layers parity. The crossings kernel is a function of the DEGREE, the layers parity is a condition on the CHARGE, and the S3 eigenvalue is CONSTANT along the charge ladder -- L(L+2) is the same value on all L+1 charges at that degree, so substituting it into the exponential leaves an expression the charge symbol does not appear in at all, gated as a statement about free symbols rather than sampled values. A function constant along the ladder cannot implement a condition that distinguishes its rungs. Exhibited rather than argued: at L = 2 the neutral charge is IN the descending sector and m = 1 is not, and the crossing assigns both the identical kernel value because both carry k squared = 8 -- one label separates them and the other cannot read it. TWO FURTHER REASONS, EACH INDEPENDENT: the filter is vacuous anyway, the rate diverging while the sound speed saturates so the kernel goes to one on every mode, reproduced as its own limit and uniform across degrees, and a filter that selects nothing has no measure to share; and the deepest reason was already in print, P16s scope note with no spacelike slice entering the map -- the crossings correspondence is null-boundary to null-boundary while the layers parity is a decomposition ON a spacelike three-geometry, so there is no spacelike datum at the crossing for that parity to be shared with. SO THE ODD-LADDER PREDICTION DOES NOT FOLLOW and the layers parity governs the layer alone; keeping the conditional half out of print at r7171 was right, and the floor rests on P16s statement, which makes ORDER TWO, re-deriving the tensor floor, load-bearing rather than tidy- up. 60 pre-registered the negative, the branch it would rather not have had, and gated that no tolerance appears anywhere in the receipt. AND THE QUESTION THAT WOULD STILL MAKE THE ODD-LADDER BOUND AVAILABLE IS NAMED, SHARP AND DIFFERENT, and 60 declined to pass this result off as it: the parity could bound the arriving content not by sharing a measure but by COMPOSITION -- if the layer is necessarily in the path, the parity bounds what arrives because the layer has no odd-degree neutral modes to carry, whatever the crossing does. So the live question is whether the layer is necessarily in the path, and 60s own pre-registration said in terms that delivering the bound that way would not answer ORDER ONE, so the negative is a negative and the composition route is untouched. It is this rows live content and is ORDERED at r7173, after ORDER TWO. AND THE TRANSMISSION FIGURE IS DELIVERABLE AFTER ALL, on 60s r7184, which narrows a limit that seat had stated twice: r7166 recorded no transmission figure, exponents only, on the ground that a figure needs the varying-lambda solution. The descending sector is the NEUTRAL slice where the charge fraction vanishes identically, so lambda = L(L+2) exactly at every squashing, gated as the squashing symbol being ABSENT rather than cancelling numerically. So k does not vary along the bead on the sector that descends and the constant-k solution is exact there. In print at r7173: the figures per even degree, T(0) = 1 to a part in ten to the fourteen as the control, and the parameter-free form read as a FLOOR on this sector rather than an estimate of it -- it understates every degree the sector contains and the lowest by about a third, 30, 17, 12, 9 and 7.5 per cent at L = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, approached from above and not crossed. The charged modes do carry a varying eigenvalue which r7174 showed diverges at the double root, and those are precisely the modes r7174 showed arrive carried in label and lost in amplitude, so the figure exists where the transport delivers an amplitude and is absent where it does not. ORDER TWO IS NOT DELIVERED AT r7175 AND WHAT IT RETURNED IS BETTER THAN THE COUNT IT WENT FOR: the floor is not a counting fact about the transverse-traceless condition, because that condition is solvable at every degree on this S3. 60 extended r7166s left-invariant frame machinery to symmetric two-tensors and, with the tool validated against the round spheres six Killing vectors, found the transverse-traceless space non-empty at every degree including L = 0 and L = 1 -- the kernel being (j+2,j) plus (j-2,j), the pieces of j tensor 2 that j tensor 1 has no slot for, matching its computation at seven consecutive levels: 5, 12, 21, 32, 50, 72, 98. So P16s the S3 tensor tower starts at L = 2 and has no k = 0 member cannot mean that the condition is unsolvable there: it is a statement about which solutions count as PERTURBATIONS, and a correct derivation has to show that. At L = 0 the five solutions are the constant left-invariant traceless tensors, the homogeneous shear, and P16s own adjacent clause excludes them in terms -- a genuinely homogeneous shear is not a perturbation of a closed ball at all, so it would be a change of background class from FRW to Bianchi IX. The exclusion was right and already in print; what was missing is that it is doing load-bearing work. AND L = 1 IS WHERE THE FLOOR THREE SITES REST ON IS THIN: twelve transverse-traceless solutions, the (5/2,1/2) piece, genuinely transverse and traceless and not homogeneous, so the L = 0 argument does not reach them -- and r7186 is why that matters, the layers parity governing the layer alone so the containment does not rescue it. BUT 60s statement that nothing in the corpus addresses them is CORRECTED at r7175, and the correction sharpens the question rather than closing it: P15s own low-multipole floor paragraph excludes the degree in one clause -- the lowest physical mode the quadrupole L = 2, the monopole L = 0 the background, the dipole L = 1 pure gauge -- in the corpus since r2419 and one paper over from where 60 was looking. So the open question is not what excludes L = 1 but whether the twelve transverse-traceless solutions at that degree are exactly the pure-gauge modes, which 60s validated machinery can compute since it already carries the gauge map whose kernel it mis- sited. ORDERED at r7175 with that pointer attached. And nothing of this is in print, deliberately: the result is in a reply and not in a receipt, so printing the standing of the towers floor would be printing on a reply, and landing it is the first half of the order. AND 60 REPORTS A PATTERN AGAINST ITSELF rather than two instances: it told this seat the machinery was broken because the gauge kernel came back 3 then 0, and the 0 was correct -- so(4) appears as (1,0) plus (0,1), three at j = 0 and three at j = 1, with nothing at j = 1/2 to find.
